verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation shows a current browser/WebGL export target, payload-size guidance, or any WebGPU roadmap. The platform-targets page mentions only devices like iOS, Android and consoles. The only browser-related item is a 2015 community remark that UE 4.7 could export to HTML5. That is a dated, legacy anecdote with no current documented support, so it does not establish the capability.
